title: [SPR1-001] Run MkDocs locally via Docker
body:
Objective: run docs locally without pip/venv hassles.

DoD:
- docker-compose service `docs` using `squidfunk/mkdocs-material:latest`.
- Makefile targets: `docs-up` / `docs-down` / `docs-build`.
- README updated with Docker quickstart.

Acceptance:
- `docker compose up docs` serves http://127.0.0.1:8000

Estimate: 1 pt

title: [SPR1-002] Repo toolchain: Makefile, pre-commit, Conventional Commits, PR template
body:
Objective: baseline DevEx.

DoD:
- Makefile targets `up/down/test/lint/format`.
- Local hooks or pre-commit for lint/format.
- `.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md` with ADR/CHANGELOG/Contracts checklist.
- Documented in README.

Acceptance:
- New PR shows the template and passes local hooks.

Estimate: 2 pts

title: [SPR1-003] Minimal CI workflow: build + unit tests
body:
Objective: basic GitHub Actions CI.

DoD:
- Workflow runs build, linters and unit tests.
- Dependency caching enabled.

Acceptance:
- Pipeline runs on each PR to `main` and is green.

Estimate: 2 pts

title: [SPR1-004] OpenAPI v1 scaffold: tenants, accounts, banks, transactions
body:
Objective: initial /v1 contract for baseline CRUD stubs.

DoD:
- `docs/contracts/openapi/v1/openapi.yaml` with paths: /v1/tenants, /v1/accounts, /v1/banks, /v1/transactions.
- Problem Details (RFC7807).
- `Idempotency-Key` header on mutations.
- OpenAPI CHANGELOG updated.

Acceptance:
- Spec validates with no errors.

Estimate: 3 pts

title: [SPR1-005] Tenant & User aggregates (in-memory) with basic RBAC
body:
Objective: model tenant and users with roles OWNER/ADMIN/USER.

DoD:
- Domain aggregates and in-memory ports.
- Invariant: creator gets OWNER on tenant creation.
- Controller stubs wired to app services.

Acceptance (Gherkin):
```
Given simulated auth
When POST /v1/tenants
Then a tenant UUID is created and the caller is OWNER
```

Estimate: 3 pts

title: [SPR1-006] Account aggregate (currency enforced: USD/EUR/COP)
body:
Objective: CHECKING/SAVINGS accounts with fixed currency.

DoD:
- Account aggregate with currency validation.
- Uniqueness (tenantId, accountName) enforced in app layer (for now).
- Stubs `POST/GET /v1/accounts`.

Acceptance:
- Reject currencies outside {USD, EUR, COP}.

Estimate: 3 pts

title: [SPR1-007] Bank entity + API stub (in-memory)
body:
Objective: bank entity per tenant with CRUD endpoints.

DoD:
- `bank` model with name, code, metadata; tenant-scoped.
- `/v1/banks` (create/list/get/delete) in-memory.

Acceptance:
- Bank created is visible only to its tenant.

Estimate: 2 pts

title: [SPR1-008] Transactions API stub with bankId + Idempotency-Key
body:
Objective: expose /v1/transactions (in-memory) including bankId.

DoD:
- DTO: accountId, bankId, amount, currency, bookingDate, sourceId.
- Idempotency by (route, Idempotency-Key) in-memory.

Acceptance (Gherkin):
```
Given a valid bankId
When POST /v1/transactions with Idempotency-Key
Then the first call returns 201 and the second returns 200 with the same body
```

Estimate: 3 pt
